abstract: This study examines the nonlinear relationship between corporate AI intensity and firm-level climate risk exposure using Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2022. We document an inverted-U-shaped relationship: climate risk exposure rises with AI intensity at lower levels, but the positive marginal association weakens and eventually turns negative as AI intensity increases. Channel analyses point to two complementary firm-level processes. Carbon emissions initially rise and then decline with AI intensity and are positively associated with climate risk exposure, whereas technological diversification initially narrows and subsequently broadens and is negatively associated with climate risk exposure. This pattern is consistent with a changing balance between AI deployment burdens and integration gains: resource and coordination demands dominate at lower AI intensity, whereas deeper AI integration increasingly enables process efficiency and broader technological search. The findings suggest that the climate implications of corporate AI depend on how deeply AI is integrated into firm operations rather than following a uniformly beneficial or harmful pattern.

abstract: Digital platforms have transformed various aspects of the industry. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the consumption of experience goods increased on online digital platforms. Users now spend more time shopping for experience goods than for search goods. However, prior studies have mainly examined generic online food delivery or product-based platforms, leaving experience goods platforms underexplored. This study aims to investigate user preferences for platform attributes, the monetary values associated with these attributes, and the levels at which they are valued. Based on a conjoint analysis, this study collected survey data from 800 Korean respondents and analyzed them using a mixed logit model. Users prioritized the platform’s main attributes, including curation, information visualization, communication channels, participation, and customization. The findings present a new perspective on experience goods platforms on which experience goods transactions occur. They describe the main strategies platform designers need, based on discussions about the role of digital platforms. The online platform has properties that facilitate information search for users’ purchasing experience goods and confirm user utility for these attributes.
title: User preferences for platform attributes in online food delivery: a conjoint analysis of experience goods platforms

abstract: This paper studies how human capital shapes both the level and direction of automation. We develop an endogenous Schumpeterian growth model in which skilled labor is allocated across production, horizontal automation of new tasks, and vertical upgrading of existing automated tasks. A positive skilled‐labor shock reallocates labor toward R&D and accelerates automation along both margins. Using China's 1999 college enrollment expansion as a natural experiment, we find that firms in skill‐intensive industries increased robot adoption significantly more after the reform, with a stronger effect on the horizontal than the vertical margin.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人力资本如何同时塑造自动化的水平与方向。我们构建了一个内生熊彼特增长模型，其中技能劳动在生产、新任务的横向自动化以及现有自动化任务的纵向升级之间进行配置。正向的技能劳动冲击会将劳动重新配置到研发部门，并沿两个边际加速自动化。以中国1999年高校扩招作为自然实验，我们发现技能密集型行业的企业在改革后显著增加了机器人采用，且对横向边际的影响强于纵向边际。

abstract: With the continuous penetration of renewable energy and electric vehicles (EVs), the structural contradictions within China's energy supply–demand system have become increasingly prominent. This paper constructs an asymmetric evolutionary game model to systematically analyze the key factors affecting the large-scale application of Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology. It further evaluates the relative effectiveness of different business models and policy instruments across multiple scenarios and estimates the optimal incentive strategies and expected total payoffs for various stakeholders in pilot cities. In addition, the study explores the supportive roles of a dynamic service pricing mechanism and an environmental benefit internalization scheme in promoting the market-oriented development of V2G. The results reveal that the input–output relationship remains the core driver of stakeholders' strategic decisions. In private community and corporate campus settings, construction subsidies are the most effective policy instruments, whereas operation subsidies perform better in public space scenarios. The optimal cooperation model varies across contexts: the self-construction mode dominates in private settings, the centralized construction and service model is preferred in corporate campuses, and both modes coexist in public spaces. Regional analysis further shows that pilot cities exhibit significant heterogeneity in their optimal guiding policies and business models across different application scenarios. Nearly half of the cities face sustainability challenges when promoting V2G deployment in corporate campuses and public space contexts. Policy simulations indicate that after subsidy withdrawal, implementing a dynamic service pricing mechanism can increase EV owners' willingness to discharge to the grid by at least 6%. Moreover, internalizing approximately 2.5% of environmental benefits enables V2G systems to achieve autonomous market operation. Overall, this study provides a novel analytical perspective for understanding strategic interactions among multiple stakeholders during the large-scale diffusion of V2G, and offers theoretical insights for designing differentiated and sustainable policy frameworks to accelerate its commercialization.
abstract_zh: 随着可再生能源与电动汽车(EV)的持续渗透，我国能源供需体系的结构性矛盾日益突出。本文构建非对称演化博弈模型，系统分析影响车网互动(V2G)技术规模化应用的关键因素，进一步评估不同商业模式与政策工具在多情景下的相对有效性，并测算试点城市各利益相关方的最优激励策略与预期总收益。此外，本研究探讨动态服务定价机制与环境效益内部化方案对推动V2G市场化发展的支撑作用。结果表明，投入产出关系仍是利益相关方策略决策的核心驱动因素。在私人社区与企业园区场景中，建设补贴是最有效的政策工具，而运营补贴在公共空间场景中表现更优。最优合作模式因情境而异：自建模式在私人场景中占主导，集中建设与服务模式在企业园区中更受青睐，两种模式在公共空间中并存。区域分析进一步显示，试点城市在不同应用场景下的最优引导政策与商业模式存在显著异质性。近半数城市在企业园区与公共空间场景中推广V2G部署时面临可持续性挑战。政策模拟表明，补贴退出后，实施动态服务定价机制可使电动汽车车主向电网放电的意愿至少提高6%。此外，将约2.5%的环境效益内部化可使V2G系统实现市场化自主运营。总体而言，本研究为理解V2G规模化扩散过程中多利益相关方之间的策略互动提供了新的分析视角，并为设计差异化、可持续的政策框架以加速其商业化提供了理论启示。

abstract: How does automation affect manufacturing firms' supply chain resilience and market diversification behavior? Using data on A-share listed manufacturing firms (2010–2019) and FactSet supply chain data, this paper investigates how industrial robot adoption impacts corporate diversification. We find that rising robot penetration significantly expands a firm's supplier and customer base, fostering a more diversified configuration. Accompanied by digital transformation, this positive effect drives diversification by lowering managerial and supply-demand coordination costs and fostering innovation. The benefits are more pronounced for non-state-owned enterprises and those in their maturity stage. Specifically, labor-intensive firms and those inside the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta clusters experience greater supplier diversification, while capital-intensive firms and those outside these regions see enhanced customer diversification. Furthermore, robot adoption strengthens customer relationship stability and prompts a strategic reconfiguration of firms' global networks, shifting supply sources toward domestic and low-income countries while expanding the customer base into high-income economies.
abstract_zh: 自动化如何影响制造企业的供应链韧性与市场多元化行为？本文利用2010—2019年A股上市制造业企业数据与FactSet供应链数据，考察工业机器人采用如何影响企业多元化。研究发现，机器人渗透率上升显著扩大了企业的供应商与客户基础，促进更为多元化的配置。伴随数字化转型，这一正向效应通过降低管理与供需协调成本、促进创新来推动多元化。该益处对非国有企业及处于成熟阶段的企业更为明显。具体而言，劳动密集型企业以及位于长三角和珠三角集群内的企业，供应商多元化程度提升更大；而资本密集型企业及位于这些区域之外的企业，客户多元化程度增强。此外，机器人采用增强了客户关系稳定性，并推动企业全球网络的战略重构，使供应来源转向国内和低收入国家，同时将客户基础扩展至高收入经济体。

abstract: The European Union is rapidly expanding its solar photovoltaic capacity, yet demand is almost entirely met by imports from China, raising concerns about supply dependence and energy security. This study quantifies the cost-risk-diversification trade-offs in the European Union’s solar photovoltaic module supply strategy for 2030. We develop a global trade model for solar photovoltaic modules that simultaneously minimizes the conflicting objectives of supply costs, geopolitical risk, and supply concentration. A scenario analysis examines three possible pathways in 2030: a policy-as-usual pathway, a globalized market structure driven by cost competitiveness, and a pathway shaped by national reshoring. A Monte Carlo simulation assesses sensitivity to parameter uncertainty. The results reveal that although the European Union’s demand increases, its dependence on imports declines, primarily due to higher domestic production capacity and improved utilization rates. Adjusting the European Union’s supply strategy by reducing geopolitical risk and supply concentration entails additional costs of up to 155 USD/kW relative to 2024 levels, driven mainly by the module prices and trade tariffs of the chosen import suppliers. Based on these results, we derive three policy implications: (i) increasing domestic production capacity to 30 GW and raising the utilization rate above 90% to strengthen the European Union’s internal supply; (ii) expanding strategic partnerships with emerging suppliers such as Vietnam (trade frequency of 82%), Thailand (81%) and Malaysia (75%) to reduce supply concentration; (iii) defining explicit benchmarks for diversification (Herfindahl-Hirschman Index < 0.15 ) and geopolitical risk exposure (43% below 2024 values) to enhance supply-chain resilience.
abstract_zh: 欧盟太阳能光伏装机容量快速扩张，但需求几乎完全依赖从中国进口，引发了对供应依赖和能源安全的担忧。本研究量化了2030年欧盟太阳能光伏组件供应战略中的成本—风险—多元化权衡。我们构建了一个太阳能光伏组件全球贸易模型，同时最小化供应成本、地缘政治风险和供应集中度这三个相互冲突的目标。情景分析考察了2030年三种可能路径：政策照常路径、由成本竞争力驱动的全球化市场结构路径，以及由国家回流塑造的路径。蒙特卡洛模拟评估了对参数不确定性的敏感性。结果表明，尽管欧盟需求增加，但其进口依赖下降，主要归因于国内产能提高和利用率改善。通过降低地缘政治风险和供应集中度来调整欧盟供应战略，相对于2024年水平会产生最高达155美元/千瓦的额外成本，主要由所选进口供应商的组件价格和贸易关税驱动。基于这些结果，我们得出三项政策启示：（i）将国内产能提高至30吉瓦，并将利用率提升至90%以上，以增强欧盟内部供应；（ii）扩大与越南（贸易频率82%）、泰国（81%）和马来西亚（75%）等新兴供应商的战略伙伴关系，以降低供应集中度；（iii）为多元化（赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数<0.15）和地缘政治风险暴露（较2024年水平低43%）设定明确基准，以增强供应链韧性。

title: The solar PV supply strategy of the European Union: A cost-risk-diversification trade-off

abstract: We study strategic coordination in a decentralized public-service system in which an upper-tier authority sets policy benchmarks exogenously, intermediate authorities compete horizontally, and local providers adjust implementation in response to performance-based incentives. Since local providers’ feasible choices depend on regional policies, we formulate the simultaneous benchmark as a generalized Nash game. The paper’s main analytical contribution is a closed-form characterization of how coupled feasibility constraints, asymmetric piecewise-quadratic benchmark losses, and projected local responses jointly affect equilibrium existence and structure. We characterize the admissible equilibrium configurations of the simultaneous benchmark, including economically relevant boundary generalized Nash equilibria, and identify three stabilizing policy levers:better-calibrated alignment premia, softer historical baselines, and a recalibration of competitive pressures across jurisdictions. We complement the theoretical analysis with Monte Carlo evidence on the Price of Anarchy and the Price of Stability and compare the simultaneous benchmark with a sequential extension solved as a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium. The Italian National Health Service provides the institutional motivation for the analysis.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个分散化公共服务体系中的战略协调问题：在该体系中，上级权威外生设定政策基准，中间层权威进行横向竞争，地方提供者根据绩效激励调整执行。由于地方提供者的可行选择取决于区域政策，我们将同时基准构建为广义纳什博弈。本文的主要分析贡献在于给出一个闭式刻画，说明耦合可行性约束、非对称分段二次基准损失与投影地方响应如何共同影响均衡的存在性与结构。我们刻画了同时基准的可行均衡配置，包括具有经济相关性的边界广义纳什均衡，并识别出三个稳定政策杠杆：校准更好的对齐溢价、更宽松的历史基线，以及重新校准跨辖区的竞争压力。我们以关于无政府状态代价与稳定性代价的蒙特卡洛证据补充理论分析，并将同时基准与作为子博弈完美纳什均衡求解的序贯扩展进行比较。意大利国家卫生服务为分析提供了制度动机。

abstract: This paper examines how common volatility in energy commodities relates to equity returns across 30 economies from 2007 to 2022, with particular attention to international trade linkages. We combine daily equity returns, bilateral trade data, and common volatility measures for aggregate energy, oil, natural gas, and coal, and estimate a heterogeneous-coefficient panel spatial autoregressive model. The baseline results show that common energy volatility is negatively associated with equity returns, with the largest absolute response observed for oil. Equity markets also display substantial dependence along the trade network, and indirect effects account for roughly half of the estimated total response. These baseline findings remain robust to alternative return measures, trade matrices, crisis exclusions, and controls for global financial conditions, and are further supported by randomized network placebo tests. Extending the analysis to different energy return states, formal tests reveal significant asymmetry between rising and falling price episodes, with the most consistent evidence found for spatial dependence, while asymmetries in volatility sensitivity and indirect effects vary across commodities. Overall, the evidence suggests that equity return responses to common energy volatility are systematically related to international trade linkages.
title: Energy market volatility and global equity returns: trade-linked dependence across economies

abstract: The online interactive platforms operated by the Shanghai Stock Exchange and Shenzhen Stock Exchange enable retail investors to conduct direct information communication with listed firms. Accordingly, this study aims to empirically examine whether such information interactions exert an impact on corporate digitalization. Specifically, this study develops a mathematical model that formalizes how digital interactions influence corporate digitalization by mitigating information asymmetry and agency costs. Empirically, it examines the impact of such digital interactions on corporate digitalization using a two‑way fixed‑effects model based on data for Chinese A‑share listed firms spanning 2012 to 2022. The results indicate that digital interactions significantly enhance corporate digitalization by reducing information costs and improving external monitoring, mechanisms that are consistent with the theoretical model’s predictions. Furthermore, these interactions positively affect four key dimensions: digital strategy, outcomes, investment, and management. In China, an emerging market characterized by institutional imperfections and low information efficiency, the governance role of retail investors is often overlooked. However, this study demonstrates that retail investors do play a role in corporate governance. It also contributes to the literature on factors driving corporate digitalization.

abstract: This paper investigates how traditional hotels compete with accommodation-sharing platforms. Using detailed data on hotels and Airbnb listings in Korea, we examine the short-run and long-run effects of Airbnb on incumbent and entrant hotels, respectively. We find that Airbnb’s low-cost room supply leads to declines in incumbent hotels’ room revenue and prices. At the same time, hotels with greater Airbnb exposure experience an increase in food and beverage (F&B) revenue, such that the net effect on total revenue becomes statistically insignificant. Over a longer horizon, we find that hotels entering local markets with more Airbnb listings have an approximately 10 percentage point higher probability of choosing a high-quality level, after correcting for selection bias. Overall, our findings suggest that the rise of Airbnb may gradually reshape the traditional hotel industry through changes in revenue composition and a shift toward higher-quality accommodations.
abstract_zh: 本文研究传统酒店如何与住宿共享平台竞争。利用韩国酒店与Airbnb房源明细数据，本文分别考察Airbnb对存量酒店与新进入酒店的短期和长期影响。研究发现，Airbnb的低价房源供给导致存量酒店的客房收入和房价下降。同时，Airbnb暴露度更高的酒店餐饮收入有所增加，使得对总收入的净影响在统计上不显著。在更长的时间跨度内，本文发现，在修正选择偏差后，进入Airbnb房源更多的地方市场的酒店选择高品质等级的概率约高出10个百分点。总体而言，本文发现表明，Airbnb的兴起可能通过收入结构的变化以及向更高品质住宿的转变，逐步重塑传统酒店业。
title: Competing with Airbnb: Evidence from Incumbent and Entrant Hotels
title_zh: 与爱彼迎竞争：来自现有酒店与新进入酒店的证据

abstract: Food taxation is increasingly proposed to improve diets, reduce health risks, and lower greenhouse gas emissions, yet equity concerns limit implementation. This study compares value-added tax reform, carbon taxation, sugar and saturated-fat taxes, a coronary heart disease risk tax, and universal and targeted food subsidies in Ireland. Using household microdata linked to nutrient and emissions data, it combines distributional characteristics, inequality measures, and microsimulation to examine how alternative food tax bases affect households across the income distribution. Baseline simulations estimate first-round financial incidence under full pass-through and fixed pre-policy quantities; a conditional Linear Expenditure System sensitivity analysis allows food-at-home purchases to respond to own-price changes. Higher-income households consume more nutrients and generate more food-related emissions in absolute terms, while saturated fat is concentrated in lower-income food baskets. All simulated taxes are financially regressive, but their source and scale differ: carbon taxation generates the largest increase in inequality, whereas sugar and saturated-fat taxes are more regressive in relative-incidence terms. Targeted subsidies partly offset regressivity. Behavioural adjustment moderates tax payments but does not alter the underlying distributional pattern.
abstract_zh: 食品税日益被提议用于改善膳食、降低健康风险和减少温室气体排放，但公平性担忧限制了其实施。本研究比较了爱尔兰的增值税改革、碳税、糖税和饱和脂肪税、冠心病风险税以及普惠性和定向性食品补贴。研究使用与营养素和排放数据相关联的家庭微观数据，结合分布特征、不平等测度和微观模拟，考察替代性食品税基如何影响不同收入分布中的家庭。基准模拟在完全转嫁和固定政策前数量的假设下估计第一轮财务归宿；条件性线性支出系统敏感性分析允许家庭内食品购买对自身价格变化作出反应。高收入家庭在绝对量上消费更多营养素并产生更多与食品相关的排放，而饱和脂肪集中于低收入家庭的食品篮子。所有模拟税收在财务上均具有累退性，但其来源和规模不同：碳税导致不平等增幅最大，而糖税和饱和脂肪税在相对归宿意义上更具累退性。定向补贴部分抵消了累退性。行为调整缓和了税款支付，但未改变潜在的分布格局。
title: Distributional characteristics of fiscal measures for food system transformation: food security, health and climate implications
title_zh: 粮食系统转型财政措施的分配特征：粮食安全、健康与气候影响

abstract: In public discourse on fiscal tensions across OECD countries, the potential contribution of higher economic growth tends to be overstated. This column argues that long-run fiscal sustainability cannot prudently rely on growth alone. OECD modelling shows that under current policy settings, productivity-led growth provides minimal fiscal relief due to wage linkages, benefit indexation, and relative price effects. Growth from rising labour utilisation is fiscally more potent, but restraining public expenditure is the surest path to long-run fiscal sustainability.
abstract_zh: 在关于经合组织国家财政紧张的公共讨论中，经济更快增长可能带来的贡献往往被夸大。本专栏认为，长期财政可持续性不能审慎地仅依赖增长。经合组织的模型显示，在当前政策设定下，由生产率驱动的增长由于工资联动、福利指数化和相对价格效应，所能提供的财政缓解极为有限。由劳动利用率上升带来的增长在财政上更为有效，但抑制公共支出才是实现长期财政可持续性最可靠的路径。
title: Growth alone is an unlikely fiscal saviour; resolving long-run fiscal tensions in OECD countries also requires expenditure restraint
title_zh: 仅靠增长难以成为财政救星；解决经合组织国家的长期财政紧张还需限制支出

abstract: Giannone et al (2026) show that aging and depopulation will lead to concentration of people in large cities such as Tokyo, while leaving old prefectures to shrink. When local public goods provision entails fixed costs, a shrinking and aging population in small localities presents a new challenge for financing these goods. I describe the financing of such goods across countries, and then discuss two avenues for future research building on their framework. First, in many countries, a major part of local taxes falls on property values, which jump once the decline becomes clear and so can decline faster than the need for local public goods. This raises the question of how local and national governments can maintain equitable access to local public goods when local property values fall before population. Second, the rapid decline necessitates national transfers, but such policies are set by elected national and local governments. Understanding how the incentives of national and local electorates evolve with aging, how they interact and how local age structures are shaped by policies is also important. Both questions are relevant for many advanced economies, where aging and depopulation are under way.
abstract_zh: Giannone等人（2026）的研究表明，人口老龄化与人口减少将导致人口向东京等大城市集中，而老旧县区则逐渐萎缩。当地方公共品的供给涉及固定成本时，小地区人口萎缩与老龄化给这类公共品的融资带来了新挑战。我描述了各国此类公共品的融资方式，然后基于他们的框架探讨了两个未来研究方向。第一，在许多国家，地方税收的很大一部分落在房产价值上，而一旦衰退趋势明朗，房产价值便会骤降，因此其下降速度可能快于对地方公共品的需求。这引出了一个问题：当地方房产价值先于人口下降时，地方和国家政府如何维持地方公共品的公平可及性。第二，人口的快速下降 necessitate 国家转移支付，但此类政策由民选的国家和地方政府制定。理解国家和地方选民的激励如何随老龄化演变、它们如何相互作用以及地方年龄结构如何被政策塑造，同样至关重要。这两个问题对许多正在经历老龄化和人口减少的发达经济体都具有相关性。
title: Who pays for a ghost town? Local public finance and the geography of aging
title_zh: 谁为鬼城买单？地方公共财政与老龄化地理
